$description: Components the web shell implements. Every component is one .dc.html fed its resolved visuals (design) and props (config + core); the shell (Backdrop Nav Skeleton.dc.html) only arranges instances (frontLayer: FrontLayer · bottomSheet / sideSheet: NowPlayingSheet, UpNextSheet · peekCard: PeekCard · layer pages: DededeLayer, AccountLayer). Interactive ones share interactive.js (state, state layer, ripple, focus ring, base motions of design/components/interactive) and own their state keyed by slot path. appBar page form: AppBarPage (the page: fills, track list, scroll thumb) holding Bar (top row) + AppBarSheet (album info + bottom row). A node is drawn by the DC of the nearest component up its extends chain that this list names (platforms/web/draw.js): drawerItem, menuItem, scrim, suggestionRow, suggestionList and checkRow have their own DCs; other variants (logo, caret, queueRow, localSearch, viewSwitch, choiceChips, errorState, playerPage) are drawn by their parent's. Page / surface components composition hires: appBarPage = AppBarPage (playerPage too: it draws the sheet slot); backdropPage = the shell's arrangement of BackLayer + FrontLayer; sheetLayer = NowPlayingSheet (bottomSheet / sideSheet); fullscreenLayer = DededeLayer, AccountLayer (no DC of their own yet; the one-renderer step gives them one). Symbols: Material Symbols Rounded (variable font).
